# webOSTV.js

`webOSTV.js` is the unchanged LG webOSTV.js 1.2.13 runtime from the [official SDK archive](https://webostv.developer.lge.com/assets/library/webOSTVjs-1.2.13.zip). The archive supplies the retained Apache 2.0 license in `LICENSE-2.0.txt`. Only `webOS.service.request` and `webOS.platformBack` are invoked by the probe; device-information, audio and other bundled helpers are not invoked. The archive is source material, not proof of TV execution.
